title: embeddings-rerank-incident-scratch - dim mismatch + latency spikes
content:
Goal: capture breadcrumbs from the 2026-03-04 -> 2026-03-05 emb/rerank incidents. Quick notes for triage and handoff.

Summary:
- Customer-impacting: reranker returning 500s for some requests and p95/p99 latency spikes observed for reranking pipeline.
- Two correlated anomalies: (A) embedding dimension mismatch errors (runtime: "expected 1536, got 1024") and (B) latency spikes (p99 from ~80ms -> ~1.2s) for rerank endpoint.
- Timeline correlation with canary rollout of embedding model variant (embedder v2.1) at ~2026-03-04T03:12:00Z.

What I saw in SLOs/metrics:
- rerank.normalized_latency.p99 increased from 80ms -> 1.2s between 03:10 and 03:20 UTC.
- error rate for /v1/rerank (500s) spiked to 4.6% at 03:14 UTC.
- embedding service logs show sporadic dimension mismatch errors starting 03:12:07Z.

Error snippets (copied from katana logs):
---
2026-03-04T03:12:07.624Z ERROR embed-service request_id=abc123 model=redwood-embed-small-2 msg="vector length mismatch" expected=1536 got=1024 client=svc-search
Trace: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: embedding length mismatch: expected 1536 but got 1024
    at ai.redwood.embed.EvIndexer.index(EvIndexer.java:214)
    at ai.redwood.embed.EmbedHandler.handle(EmbedHandler.java:89)
---
2026-03-04T03:12:12.001Z ERROR rerank-service request_id=def456 msg="rerank failed: upstream embedding error" status=500 upstream_err="embedding length mismatch"
---
2026-03-04T03:15:03.112Z WARN rerank-service latency=1208ms p99=1208ms route=/v1/rerank model=semantic-reranker-1 note="queueing/backpressure observed"
---

Commands I ran (local reproductions):
- curl reproduce embedding call (returned 1024-length vector):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-small-2","input":"hello world"}' | jq -r '.data[0].embedding | length'
  -> returned 1024

- same call against pinned model (redwood-embed-small-1): returned 1536

- rerank call that failed (example):
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"query_embedding": [ ... 1024 dims ... ], "candidates": [...] }'
  -> 500 with "embedding length mismatch"

Infra debug commands:
- kubectl -n serving get pods -l app=embed-service
  -> 3 pods, one pod (embed-canary-2) restarted around 03:12:05Z
- kubectl -n serving logs pod/embed-canary-2 | grep "model load"
  -> "Loaded model redwood-embed-small-2 dims=1024"
- kubectl -n serving logs pod/embed-prod-1 | grep "model load"
  -> "Loaded model redwood-embed-small-1 dims=1536"
- Checked autoscaler: no scale events other than expected.

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Canary rollout swapped in a different embedder binary or model artifact (redwood-embed-small-2 with 1024 dims) that is incompatible with downstream reranker expecting 1536-dim vectors. This is supported by pod logs showing dims=1024 for canary.
2) Client-side: some clients sending legacy vectors (1024) due to cached SDK or local transform. Less likely because embed-service itself returns 1024 when asked with new model.
3) Batching/serialization bug: new runtime changed packing so occasional truncation/padding occurs. (Look for off-by-one buffer allocation in serving runtime.)
4) Latency spike caused by synchronous fallback: when reranker sees mismatched dims it retries/backs off, causing queue build-up. Or reranker waiting for embeddings from an overloaded canary embedding pod.

Notes about rollout and config we saw:
- Ops mentioned a canary-only rollout of embedder v2.1 to 10% traffic at 03:10 UTC. Canary pods got the new artifact; prod pods still on v2.0.
- Model registry entry for redwood-embed-small-2 lists embedding_dim=1024 in metadata (I pulled the registry JSON).
- No canary-aware type checking in reranker service: reranker assumes embedding_dim=1536 globally based on config in prod.

Immediate mitigation ideas tried / considered:
- Rollback canary: ops rolled back embedder canary at 03:22 UTC. After rollback, dimension mismatch errors ceased and rerank error rate dropped back to baseline by 03:30 UTC. Latency recovered gradually. (Status: ACTIONED by ops)
- Add a quick server-side validation to rerank: check embedding length and return 400 with clearer message instead of internal 500 (prevents expensive stack traces and avoids internal retries). (Status: TODO, low-effort)
- Add canary-aware model metadata propagation: reranker should read embedding_dim from model metadata or from request wrapper, not assume a single fixed dim. (Status: TODO)
- Instrument queue lengths and backpressure more finely in reranker. (Status: TODO)

Postmortem anchors / follow-ups:
- Root cause likely mis-coordinated model variant that changed vector dimensionality without a compatibility check in downstream services.
- Action items:
  1) [High] Add embedding_dim sanity check at rerank service and return 4xx. (owner: Evelyn)
  2) [High] Model registry validation: prevent model variants that change dim from being rolled out to shared endpoints without explicit compatibility flag. (owner: Platform)
  3) [Medium] CI check for embedding_dim alignment between embedding-service and reranker smoke test. (owner: Eng Test)
  4) [Medium] Post-incident add a canary traffic isolation policy for experiments that change schema-like attributes. (owner: Release Eng)
  5) [Low] Add docs for SDK consumers about embedding dims and version pinning. (owner: Docs)

Repro notes for a dev:
1) curl embedding with model redwood-embed-small-2 and check length (should be 1024)
2) call rerank service using that vector and observe 500 (or 400 if we change behavior)
3) check pod logs for embed-canary-2 and grep for "Loaded model"

Open questions / things I couldn't find quickly:
- Who approved redwood-embed-small-2 metadata change? (owner: model-registry audit)
- Was there any SDK release pinned to the new model that could have caused client-side usage?
- Why did reranker assume 1536? Where is that wired? (config or hard-coded?)

Next steps for handoff:
- @Maya: pick up 1) (validation in reranker) and draft a minimal PR that returns 400 + structured error (include expected_dim in payload).
- @Evelyn: coordinate with Platform to add registry block for dim-incompatible rollouts.
- I (Jordan) will add timeline + logs to JIRA-REINF-1245 and attach pod logs + sample payloads.

Quick logs & artifacts to attach to ticket:
- embed-canary-2 logs (03:10-03:25)
- rerank error traces (def456, ghi789)
- embedding registry JSON snapshots for small-1 and small-2
- curl reproduction commands and outputs (already captured above)

If anything else needed for debugging ping in slack #eng-embeddings and tag me (jordan).

-- scratch / notes done 2026-03-05 09:12 PST
